description: This file defines a Java record `CartItemResponse` in the package `com.shopizer.checkout.client.dto` that serves as a minimal data transfer object (DTO) representing a cart item for the checkout service. It includes a method to derive a SKU-like identifier from the product ID UUID.

classes.name: CartItemResponse
classes.description: A Java record representing a cart item with a UUID product ID and quantity, providing a method to generate a SKU-like string identifier.

methods.name: sku
methods.description: Returns a SKU-like string identifier based on the productId UUID, or null if productId is null.
